title: Poietic Agents
description: TLDR: Test whether initially identical agents can develop efficient shared data services and cheaper execution without losing fresh, correct answers. Compare with generalists, coherent caching and static specialists; count correct fresh on-time work and full lifecycle cost. S0-02 stopped after one Haiku response with fenced/nested JSON: 1 started, 143 unstarted, 144 terminal. No model qualifies and no swarm effect is established. All 12 artifacts verified; allocation released. Offline action-contract/billing repair passes 106 offline checks. A complete 36-decision diagnostic runner is proposed, unapproved and not launched. Cumulative conservative exposure USD 0.562186183 under the original USD 2 cap; S1/S2 closed.
